overview: The toolkit's top-level, self-managing video surface for Zoom Video SDK sessions. Renders a horizontally paged scroll view of (optional local share panel) + (remote share receive views) + (participant camera grid pages), a page control, a floating self-video overlay (in multi-user mode), a cloud-recording badge, and integrates system Picture-in-Picture. It registers with ZMUIToolKitManager.videoSDKDelegate (NOT ZoomVideoSDK.delegate directly) on window attach and reacts to SDK delegate callbacks to keep the grid, shares, recording badge, and PiP source authoritative. Also observes device orientation, app active/resign, and PiP-enabled notifications.

typeDefinitions.name: ZMUIToolkitVideoPage
typeDefinitions.notes: UIView holding up to 4 ZMUIToolkitVideoCells; 1 participant => primary (full-size) layout, 2-4 => grid layout. Renders only when not hidden.

typeDefinitions.name: ZMUIToolkitVideoOverlayLayerView
typeDefinitions.role: floating layer hosting the self-overlay cell above grid pages

typeDefinitions.name: ZMUIToolkitSharePanelView
typeDefinitions.notes: Stop Sharing button + 'Share device audio' UISwitch. Always page index 0 when present.

typeDefinitions.name: ZMUIToolkitShareReceiveView
typeDefinitions.notes: Marks the canvas subscribed on .Errors_Success and retries the subscription on the next layout/appear.

typeDefinitions.name: ZMUIToolkitShareViewManager
typeDefinitions.notes: Prevents duplicate subscriptions when parent views are recreated (rotation).

typeDefinitions.name: ZMRecordingManager
typeDefinitions.role: owns recording consent dialog/toast and recording state
typeDefinitions.notes: init() of the video view touches ZMRecordingManager.shared so it is registered as an SDK delegate.

typeDefinitions.name: ZMUIToolKitManager
typeDefinitions.role: holds ZoomVideoSDK instance, videoSDKDelegate fan-out, cloudRecordingConsentDialogEnabled

typeDefinitions.name: CompositeZoomVideoSDKDelegate
typeDefinitions.role: weak fan-out delegate; register via add(_:) / remove(_:)

typeDefinitions.name: ZoomVideoSDKRecordingStatus
typeDefinitions.notes: Other statuses ignored by this view.

lifecycle.description: Construction builds subviews and observers. Delegate registration, rendering, and PiP attachment are driven by window attachment (didMoveToWindow): add the view to a window to begin receiving live session updates. The view becomes useful after ZMUIToolKitManager.initialize and once added to a window.
prerequisites: Zoom Video SDK initialized and registered with the toolkit via ZMUIToolKitManager.initialize(videoSDK:bundleId:) BEFORE the view can render real session content.
Construct and use on the main thread (@MainActor).
Add the view to a window/view hierarchy; delegate registration and rendering happen on didMoveToWindow.
lifecycle.ifNotInitialized: If ZMUIToolKitManager.videoSDK?.getSession() is nil at init, the view skips populating users/shares/PiP and waits for onSessionJoin/onUserJoin callbacks.

actions: touch ZMRecordingManager.shared (registers it as an SDK delegate)
register NotificationCenter observers (orientation, willResignActive, didBecomeActive, pipEnabledDidChange)
if session exists: displayallUsers(), displayActiveRemoteShares(), updatePiPActiveUser()
entryPoints.note: Adds self to the delegate fan-out on window attach (didMoveToWindow).

actions: remove tracked share views from scrollView (singleton retains them)

lifecycle.delegateModel: The view does NOT assign itself to ZoomVideoSDK.delegate. It registers with the toolkit fan-out delegate ZMUIToolKitManager.videoSDKDelegate (CompositeZoomVideoSDKDelegate) on window attach, enabling multiple observers. Child delegates are stored weakly.

onSessionLeave.behavior: Calls ZMUIToolkitPiPController.shared.sessionDidEnd() to tear down PiP for the ended session.
notes: Tears PiP down for the ended session.
Does not itself clear the grid; the view is typically removed afterward.

onWindowDetach.description: View removed from window (window == nil in didMoveToWindow).
onWindowDetach.behavior: Removes delegate, removes share views from scrollView, detaches PiP, stops rendering.
notes: Add the view to a window to begin receiving live session updates; it observes SDK events while on screen and stops when removed.

onAppResignActive.behavior: updateRenderStates() stops inline rendering; system PiP renders off its own raw-data subscription.
notes: Inline canvases disappear; PiP continues independently.

onAppBecomeActive.description: App returns to foreground while in a window.
onAppBecomeActive.behavior: Stops any active system PiP window (stopPiPIfActive) and resumes inline rendering.

onDeviceRotation.behavior: rotateMyVideo(orientation), rebalanceVideoPagesForCurrentLayout(), re-sync remote shares (may need re-adding to new view instance).

pageModel.orderedPages: [ sharePanelView? ] + [ remote share receive views per activeShareSourceIds ] + [ video grid pages ]
pageModel.localSharePanel: ZMUIToolkitSharePanelView; present only while local user shares; always index 0 when present.
pageModel.remoteShares: One ZMUIToolkitShareReceiveView per active remote share source; first remote share at remoteShareStartIndex (0 if no local panel, else 1).
pageModel.videoGridPages: ZMUIToolkitVideoPage displays up to 4 participant video cells per page; 1 participant => primary layout, 2-4 => grid; overflow on additional pages.
pageModel.currentPageIndex: currPgIdx indexes into allPages; adjusted on share add/remove, user leave, rebalance, and scroll.
pageModel.renderGating: Visible page renders video; off-screen pages call disappearFromScreen() to unsubscribe. Gated by shouldRenderPageContent (window != nil && app state == .active).

selfPresentation.multiUser: Local camera removed from grid pages; shown by floating selfOverlayLayerView overlay cell above grid pages. Hidden on share pages or invalid current page.
selfPresentation.solo: Local user inserted as a full-size cell in the first video page; overlay hidden.

behaviorFlags.name: shouldRenderPageContent
behaviorFlags.meaning: Gates whether the visible page and self-overlay subscribe/render video.

behaviorFlags.name: shouldUseSelfOverlay
behaviorFlags.meaning: Drives overlay-vs-solo self presentation (addedUsers tracks remote users only).

behaviorFlags.name: remoteShareStartIndex
behaviorFlags.value: 0 if no local share panel, else 1

behaviorFlags.name: currPgIdx
behaviorFlags.value: index into allPages of the visible page
behaviorFlags.meaning: Adjusted on share add/remove, user leave, rebalance, and scroll.

apis.name: init
apis.description: Builds all subviews, registers notification observers, ensures the recording manager exists, and (if a session is active) populates users, remote shares, and the PiP source.
sideEffects: Touches ZMRecordingManager.shared (registers it as an SDK delegate)
Adds NotificationCenter observers (orientation, willResignActive, didBecomeActive, pipEnabledDidChange)
If session exists: displayallUsers(), displayActiveRemoteShares(), updatePiPActiveUser()
Does NOT add self to the delegate fan-out (deferred to didMoveToWindow)

apis.name: init(coder:)
apis.description: NOT SUPPORTED. Calls fatalError. Do not instantiate from Storyboard/XIB.

apis.name: setPosition
apis.signature: @objc public func setPosition(x: Int, y: Int)
apis.description: Sets the view origin, preserving current size.

apis.name: setSize
apis.signature: @objc public func setSize(width: Int, height: Int)
apis.description: Sets the view size, preserving current origin. Triggers layoutSubviews which recomputes page frames and rebalances grid pages if the per-page cell count changed.

apis.name: layoutSubviews
apis.description: Lays out scrollView, self-overlay layer, page control, recording indicator; brings them to front; rebalances video pages if maxVideoCellsPerPage() changed. Called by UIKit.

apis.name: didMoveToWindow
apis.description: Window attach/detach hook. On attach: add delegate, sync recording indicator, resume rendering (if active), attach PiP, update PiP source. On detach: remove delegate, remove share views from scrollView, detach PiP, stop rendering.
sideEffects: Delegate add/remove; PiP attach/detach; render state updates

callbacks.name: onSessionJoin
callbacks.description: Local user joined the session. Syncs active remote shares for existing remote users.
callbacks.effect: ensures in-progress remote shares get a receive view/page

callbacks.name: onSessionLeave
callbacks.description: Session ended. Calls ZMUIToolkitPiPController.shared.sessionDidEnd() to tear down PiP for the ended session.
callbacks.effect: tears PiP down for the ended session

callbacks.name: onUserJoin
callbacks.signature: public func onUserJoin(_ helper: ZoomVideoSDKUserHelper?, users: [ZoomVideoSDKUser]?)
callbacks.description: New users joined. Adds them to grid pages, syncs any remote shares they already have, re-evaluates PiP source.

callbacks.name: onUserLeave
callbacks.signature: public func onUserLeave(_ helper: ZoomVideoSDKUserHelper?, users: [ZoomVideoSDKUser]?)
callbacks.description: Users left. Removes their remote share pages, deletes their video cell, compacts grid pages (pulls a cell from tail page, drops emptied trailing pages), updates page visibility and PiP.
callbacks.effect: remove share pages; delete cells; compact pages; updatePageVisibility; updatePiPActiveUser

callbacks.name: onUserAudioStatusChanged
callbacks.signature: public func onUserAudioStatusChanged(_ helper: ZoomVideoSDKAudioHelper?, user users: [ZoomVideoSDKUser]?)
callbacks.description: Updates the mute icon on each affected user's grid cell, and on the self-overlay cell for the local user.

callbacks.name: onUserActiveAudioChanged
callbacks.signature: public func onUserActiveAudioChanged(_ helper: ZoomVideoSDKUserHelper?, users: [ZoomVideoSDKUser]?)
callbacks.description: Computes actively-talking user IDs (audioStatus()?.talking == true) and updates the active-speaker highlight on all grid cells and the self-overlay cell.

callbacks.name: onUserVideoStatusChanged
callbacks.signature: public func onUserVideoStatusChanged(_ helper: ZoomVideoSDKVideoHelper?, user users: [ZoomVideoSDKUser]?)
callbacks.description: Renders or turns off video for each user based on canvas videoStatus().on (including the self-overlay cell for the local user), then re-evaluates PiP source. Skips users with no video canvas.
callbacks.effect: turnOnVideo/turnOffVideo per page; selfOverlayCell render/turnOff; updatePiPActiveUser

callbacks.name: onUserNameChanged
callbacks.description: Updates the displayed name on the user's grid cell and the self-overlay cell if it is the local user.

callbacks.name: onVideoCanvasSubscribeFail
callbacks.signature: public func onVideoCanvasSubscribeFail(_ failReason: ZoomVideoSDKSubscribeFailReason, user: ZoomVideoSDKUser?, view: UIView?)
callbacks.description: Video subscription failed. Turns off that user's video on all grid pages and refreshes page visibility. No retry.

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: User whose canvas failed to subscribe

callbacks.name: onUserShareStatusChanged
callbacks.signature: public func onUserShareStatusChanged(_ helper: ZoomVideoSDKShareHelper?, user: ZoomVideoSDKUser?, shareAction: ZoomVideoSDKShareAction?)
callbacks.description: Primary share driver. Local user: .start/.resume => add local share panel page and jump to it (page 0); .none/.stop => remove panel. Remote user: .start/.resume => ensure remote share receive view/page and jump to it; .none/.stop => remove that remote share page.

parameters.name: shareAction
parameters.description: The share action (status, source id, canvas)

callbacks.name: onCloudRecordingStatus
callbacks.signature: public func onCloudRecordingStatus(_ status: ZoomVideoSDKRecordingStatus, recordAgreementHandler handler: ZoomVideoSDKRecordAgreementHandler?)
callbacks.description: Drives the recording indicator badge only. .start => visible/not paused (red REC); .pause => visible/paused (grey pause); .stop => hidden; other statuses ignored.

parameters.name: handler
parameters.ifNotHandled: Consent is NOT handled by this view; ZMRecordingManager.shared handles the consent dialog/toast.
parameters.description: Record agreement (consent) handler — NOT called by this view.

notes: This view does NOT call recordAgreementHandler.
Consent dialog/toast handled by ZMRecordingManager.shared (registered by init()).

callbacks.name: scrollViewDidEndDecelerating
callbacks.description: After a user swipe settles: compute new page index, hide/disappear previous page, show/refresh new page (refresh metadata tags for video pages), update self-overlay, page control, and PiP source.
callbacks.effect: currPgIdx update; render previous off / new on; updateSelfOverlayState; updatePageControlState; updatePiPActiveUser

notificationObservers.effect: rotateMyVideo; rebalanceVideoPagesForCurrentLayout; syncActiveRemoteShares (re-add to new view instance)
updateRenderStates() — stop inline rendering (PiP renders independently)
if in window: stopPiPIfActive(); updateRenderStates() resume rendering

priority: 1. Active remote screen share (activeRemoteShareForPiP — prefers currently-viewed share, else first live one). Local ReplayKit shares ignored.
2. A visible remote camera that is on (from currentVideoPageUserIDs()).
3. The local camera if it is on.
pipSourceSelection.attachment: PiP attached on window-attach; detached on window-detach / cleanup() / sessionDidEnd().

errorHandling.description: This view does not surface SDK-level errors (onError) itself. State is reconciled by subsequent SDK delegate callbacks.

byArea.handling: Delegated to ZMUIToolkitShareReceiveView; marks subscribed on .Errors_Success and retries the subscription on the next layoutSubviews/appearOnScreen.
ZMUIToolkitPiPController retires receivers as sessions and sources change.

errorHandling.retryStrategy: State is reconciled by subsequent SDK delegate callbacks. To observe SDK events (including errors), register your own ZoomVideoSDKDelegate via ZMUIToolKitManager.videoSDKDelegate.add(_:).
recoveryActions: State reconciled by subsequent SDK delegate callbacks.

required: Initialize the toolkit (ZMUIToolKitManager.initialize) before the view can render real session content.
Construct and use the view on the main thread (@MainActor).

Add the view to a window/view hierarchy — delegate registration, rendering, and PiP attachment are driven by didMoveToWindow; the view observes SDK events while on screen and stops when removed, so place it in your view hierarchy to receive live session updates.
forbidden: Instantiating via init?(coder:) / Interface Builder (traps with fatalError).
Assigning this view (or anything) directly to ZoomVideoSDK.delegate; use ZMUIToolKitManager.videoSDKDelegate.add(_:).

invariants.rule: Remote share receive views are owned by the ZMUIToolkitShareViewManager singleton.
invariants.implication: This view only adds/removes them from its scroll view, so they survive parent recreation during rotation.
